key_points: Multiple broker upgrades and price target hikes (JPMorgan, BofA, Globe and Mail) reinforce bullish outlook.
Institutional buying evident with several funds increasing holdings, while a few reduce positions.
Short-term volatility persists, with retail sentiment split and occasional forecast‑miss concerns.
BofA notes shorter iPhone 18 Pro wait times, suggesting improving demand for upcoming models.
Apple’s global smartphone share rose to 22% despite a 20% market slump, indicating share gains.
